vedic_reference.note: Lavith is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Radiant, Shining, Bright'. It can be derived from the Sanskrit words 'लवित्' (lavit) meaning 'Shining, Radiant' and 'सूर्य' (surya) meaning 'Sun'. The long meaning of the name is 'सूर्यस्य विकास' (suryasya vikas) meaning 'Sun's Growth' or 'Surya Seva' meaning 'Service to the Sun'.
